name: mastodon
description_en: Your self-hosted, globally interconnected microblogging community
readme_excerpt: > [!NOTE] > Want to learn more about Mastodon? > Click below to find out more in a video. Mastodon is a free, open-source social network server based on ActivityPub where users can follow friends and discover new ones. On Mastodon, users can publish anything they want: links, pictures, text, and video.
